vsam.why: hc-file-unlock: hcuf.txt records, 4-byte key, 16-byte records (CSD DEFINE FILE has a DSNAME, no IDCAMS)

notes: cics-crucible condition-handling / hc-file-unlock (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): READ UPDATE / REWRITE / UNLOCK on a KSDS (K001..K003); REWRITE after UNLOCK, UNLOCK with nothing held, READ INTO with LENGTH below the record (LENGERR). Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs. Scenarios U (UNLOCK after READ UPDATE, then REWRITE with nothing held) and N (UNLOCK and REWRITE with nothing held, READ of K001) are in too: the harness compares the READ / REWRITE / UNLOCK events both sides record (#7434).

scenarios.name: update-rewrite
scenarios.why: READ UPDATE of K002, REWRITE, READ again

scenarios.name: read-short
scenarios.why: READ INTO of K002 with LENGTH 8 on a 16-byte record (LENGERR), then LENGTH 16

scenarios.name: unlock-rewrite
scenarios.why: READ UPDATE of K002, UNLOCK, REWRITE with nothing held, READ again

scenarios.name: unlock-nothing
scenarios.why: UNLOCK with no READ UPDATE, REWRITE with no READ UPDATE, READ of K001

scenarios.name: read-notfound
scenarios.why: mode N on a file without K001: the final READ answers NOTFND, so LOG-D takes its RESP not zero arm

scenarios.name: unmatched-mode
scenarios.why: a mode no WHEN names: the EVALUATE falls through
